What We're Looking For
Ever found yourself trapped in endless meetings where discussions spiral, approvals pile up, and not a single line of meaningful code gets shipped? Or spent your time optimizing a tiny corner of a massive system, wondering whether your work actually matters?
If those scenarios sound familiar, HeyMax is built for a different kind of engineer. We are a fast-moving fintech startup where your work matters, your ideas count, and you can make a direct difference for users.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who wants to build meaningful products in an environment where engineering impact is direct, visible, and amplified by AI. You should be the kind of engineer who already uses tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar systems to move faster across implementation, debugging, testing, and code review.
You care about shipping quickly, but not carelessly. You bring strong judgment, technical depth, and the ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into reliable systems used by real customers across multiple markets.
What You'll Do

•
Build High-Impact Product Features: Design, implement, and ship features that improve how users earn, track, and redeem rewards through HeyMax .

•
Use AI-Augmented Development: Apply AI tools across your daily workflow, from exploring requirements and generating implementation plans to testing, debugging, and reviewing code.

•
Own Technical Design: Make sound design decisions for the systems and features you work on, balancing speed, reliability, maintainability, and product impact.

•
Stay Hands-On: Spend most of your time building. We value senior engineers who stay close to the code and understand the details of what they ship.

•
Improve Engineering Quality: Write clean, maintainable code, improve observability, strengthen tests, and help keep our systems reliable as we scale.

•
Collaborate Across Functions: Work closely with product, design, business, and operations teams to translate customer and business needs into practical technical solutions.

•
Mentor Through Example: Support other engineers through code reviews, pairing, thoughtful feedback, and by sharing effective AI-assisted development patterns.

Responsibilities
With great power comes great responsibility. Here's what you'll own:

• Build and maintain production-grade systems across mobile, backend, infrastructure, data, or AI-related surfaces.

• Take projects from ambiguous requirements to shipped, measurable outcomes.

• Contribute to architecture discussions and own technical decisions within your project areas.

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate development while maintaining strong engineering judgment.

• Review code, improve implementation quality, and help the team move quickly without sacrificing reliability.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business context and deliver practical solutions.

• Identify technical debt, reliability gaps, and opportunities to improve developer velocity.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong software engineering experience, ideally with a track record of delivering complex projects end-to-end.

title: Commercial Manager, West
description:
COMMERCIAL MANAGER WEST

Location: US West (remote), strong interest for San Francisco

THE ROLE

Our commercial segment is one of the more technically demanding sales environments in the industry. Our buyers are data engineers, platform architects, and technical founders - and the AEs who succeed here do so because they can meet those buyers as peers, not vendors. Building and leading that team requires someone who has done it themselves and knows what great looks like.

As Manager of Commercial Sales at ClickHouse, you'll own the performance, development, and culture of our Commercial AE team. You'll be expected to live in the details - reviewing pipelines, sitting on calls, pressure-testing deal strategy, and knowing every meaningful opportunity in the book. The best managers in this role won't be directing from a distance; they'll be the person their reps turn to when a deal gets complicated. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a dashboard. It's a role for someone who wants to build something.

You'll inherit a team that has real momentum, as our Commercial segment represents a significant % of our overall business.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Executives selling into the sub-250 employee segment - helping them close faster, think more technically, and operate with greater autonomy over time.

- Own the Commercial segment number. You're accountable for team attainment, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy - and you'll be expected to have a clear point of view on both at any given moment.

- Spend time in deals. Review deals, join customer conversations when it matters, and help your reps navigate the technical and commercial complexity that defines this segment.

- Hire exceptional people. The Commercial AE profile is rare: technically credible, commercially hungry, and able to operate without hand-holding. You know how to find and close that person.

- Build the playbook. Document what's working, codify best practices, and create repeatable frameworks for technical discovery, objection handling, and deal progression that the team can scale.

- Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing to ensure the Commercial team has the support, enablement, and feedback loops they need to win.

- Identify patterns across the pipeline - where deals stall, where we lose, and where we consistently win - and use those insights to improve team performance and inform product and GTM decisions.

- Contribute to the broader Commercial strategy, including segmentation, coverage model, and how we evolve the motion as the team scales.

WHAT YOU BRING

- A track record of success as a quota-carrying AE in a technical sales environment - you've sold data infrastructure, developer tooling, or a similarly technical product to engineering buyers and you know what that motion actually requires.

About the role

Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. The loads involved are large enough - and arrive fast enough - that utility supply alone often can't meet the need on the timeline required, and the step-load behavior of large accelerator clusters creates power-quality and ride-through demands that conventional backup-generation designs weren't built for. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for solving that problem: delivering facilities that can be energized early, ride through grid disturbances, and present a well-behaved load at the point of interconnection (POI).

 

As a Data Center Power Generation & Microgrids Engineer, you'll own the behind-the-meter generation and storage architecture for Anthropic's data center portfolio. That means the on-site generation fleet - reciprocating engine gensets, gas turbines, fuel cells - and the battery energy storage systems that buffer load steps and provide ride-through. It means the microgrid layer that ties them together: islanding and resynchronization, black-start, load-shedding, and generation dispatch. And it means the grid side: interconnection studies and agreements, IEEE 1547/2800 compliance, and power quality at the point of interconnection. You'll also own our temporary- and bridging-generation strategies - the plans that let a site energize and start serving load before permanent utility service is available, and transition cleanly once it is.

Legends Global is the premier partner to the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands. We deliver a fully integrated suite of premium services through a white-label model that keeps our partners front and center - from feasibility and project development to sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and world-class content and booking.
